title: wpml_edit_history, version 2 (draft 3.1 for format version 9)
description: The key inside one jobs[] item of POST /api/wpml/jobs, object version 2: version 1 with a compact encoding. texts holds only texts that are not in the job's XLIFF as received; an item may point at a table row (t) or at the current source or target (s) of a trans-unit of that XLIFF, the one named by k, or by u when the item has no key or points at another unit; a list may hold spans over the previous carried list, and a translation list may be the string "file". s and u are references by value: u is never a key. Everything else is version 1. A top-level null is no key (today's job) and is read before this schema; a value that is not an object is history_invalid; inside the key, null, false and [] stand for an empty or absent value where WPML's PHP sends them, and an id of last_applied or dropped_job may arrive as a numeric string. The schema is closed.

watermark.description: The id of the newest entry carried.

compacted.description: true when entries were cut to fit; false or null reads as absent.

texts.description: The texts of the past, each once: texts that are not the current source or target of a trans-unit of this file. The empty string is a row when a list holds an emptied unit. A row equal to a text of the file does no harm.

base.description: The baseline: the last applied delivery's targets (units) and the sources at that time (original). Base lists hold no span; base.original is never "file".

structure.description: Per entry id: an element key; "unkeyed", one mark on the entry when the structure or styling of an element without an id changed, with no position; or "page" for the typed page settings.

item.description: One unit at its place in an ordered list; its position is its index after every span is expanded. k is the unit's key (version 8, 4.5), absent for a unit WPML cannot name. Its text is row t of texts, or the current s (source or target) of a trans-unit of the job's XLIFF as received: the text content of that element after XML decoding and before any parse of ATE's. The trans-unit is the one whose id is k, or u when the item has no key or its text equals another trans-unit's current text. u is a reference by value and never a key: an item without k is unkeyed whatever its u.

span.description: count items copied unchanged, key and text, from positions from .. from+count-1 of the previous carried list: for a translation list the previous entry's units, else base.units; for an original list the nearest earlier entry that carries original, else base.original. A span never copies an item whose key a rename has retired (in a translation list, an old key of this entry's renamed; in an original list, an old key of the renamed of any entry after the copied list, up to this one): such a position is written as an item with its new key.

file.description: A translation list that, expanded, equals item for item: every trans-unit of the file in file order (a trans-unit with translate="no" is not one), each keyed by its id (a key under version 8's 4.5, not a handle), each with a non-empty target that is the unit's current text, and nothing else. An original list is never "file".

time.description: UTC epoch seconds at the end of the user action.

original.description: The original's units at that save; absent or null when unchanged.

renamed.description: Keys WPML itself re-issued since the previous carried list: old key -> new key, composed over merged or cut entries; empty, [] or null reads as none.

id.description: An id of 1 or more: an integer, or its numeric string as WPML's PHP may send it, which ATE reads as the integer.

delivery_id.description: translated_xliffs.id; absent only for a delivery applied before the site's cutover, which WPML 5.x did not record.

empty.description: An empty PHP array, which WPML's encode, decode, encode round trip sends for an empty map.
